logger.doc:name: Log rerun request
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'Rerun requested periodDate=' ++ (payload.periodDate as String) ++ ' operator=' ++ (payload.operator default 'n/a') ++ ' reason=' ++ (payload.reason as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var req = vars.rerunRequest var periodEnd = ((req.periodDate as String) ++ "T21:30:00+05:30") as DateTime var reportedUpto = payload.last_reported_upto as DateTime --- { reportType: payload.report_type default p('report.type'), entityCode: payload.entity_code default p('report.entityCode'), periodStart: periodEnd - |P1D|, periodEnd: periodEnd, triggeredBy: "API", alreadyReported: periodEnd <= reportedUpto }

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST
raise-error.description: periodDate must be a past business date that has already been reported. Use the scheduler for unreported periods.

db:select.doc:name: Check period in progress
db:select.db:sql: SELECT count(*) AS in_progress FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode AND period_start = CAST(CAST(:periodStart AS text) AS timestamptz) AND run_status = 'CLAIMED' AND started_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'

raise-error.doc:name: Raise PERIOD_CONFLICT
raise-error.description: A run for this period is already in progress
